_note: Mirrors :root in src/styles.css (Verified). Only bank.* and range-chip tokens are new (AIO-93). Shell tokens added in AIO-140.

bank.--bank-primary: per bank, from config; falls back to --accent
bank.--bank-on: text on a bank-primary fill: #ffffff or #14110a, whichever gives >= 4.5:1
bank.rule: Bank colour is for fills, bars and icons only. Never use it as text colour on --surface.

derived.note: Declare derived tokens on the same element as --bank-primary so they follow it.

focus: 2px solid var(--text), offset 2px (never relies on bank colour); on the dark sidebar 2px solid #ffffff
